A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GeoRanker work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original GeoRanker evaluations on IM2GPS3K and YFCC4K, component ablations, hyperparameter studies, efficiency measurements, and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2 retains these original results and adds ranking-metric evaluation and retrieval-pool-size experiments in Appendices F and I.

M1.justification: The retrieval pipeline, LVLM/LoRA ranker, prompts, multi-order losses, and candidate selection remain unchanged. Section 3.4 adds Cneg explicitly to the scoring expression, clarifying negative context already described and ablated during inference in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use MP16-Pro to construct GeoRanking and evaluate on IM2GPS3K and YFCC4K. The added analyses retain this coverage; ranking metrics and retrieval-pool subsampling change evaluation procedures and sample sizes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 1 and 3 is unchanged. Appendix F evaluates the existing G3 retrieval approach using ranking metrics; G3-based embedding ranking was already compared as Top1 in Section 4.5. The four newly cited works are not evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: New Appendix F evaluates G3's top-20 retrieved candidates using Recall@K and NDCG@K, specifying nearest-candidate ground truth and distance-based relevance labels. Appendix I adds inference evaluations with 10%, 25%, and 50% of the retrieval pool. Previously reported experimental settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix I adds sensitivity analysis of retrieval-pool size, distinct from v1's per-query candidate-count studies. Appendix F directly examines ranking quality. Existing component ablations, hyperparameter analyses, efficiency studies, backbone scaling, and case studies are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates and curves without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new appendix tables follow the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: Existing benchmark and ablation values remain unchanged. New Table 5 reports Recall@1 of 0.0894 for G3 Retrieval versus 0.1982 for GeoRanker, alongside other ranking scores. New Table 7 reports pool-size results, including 1km accuracy of 14.91% at 10% versus 18.79% at 100%. These are additional evaluations, not version-to-version performance gains.

T1.justification: The loss definitions and mathematical reasoning in Section 3.3 are unchanged. Explicitly including Cneg in the inference notation restates existing conditioning. The added ranking metrics are evaluation specifications; no theoretical result, assumption, or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about distance-aware ranking, multi-order supervision, GeoRanking's novelty, and state-of-the-art benchmark performance. Additional experiments support these existing claims; the new abstract sentence concerns resource availability.

C2.justification: Appendix I newly interprets larger retrieval pools as especially beneficial for fine-grained localization. Its claim of consistent improvement overlooks the 750km decrease from 76.74% at 50% to 76.31% at 100%. Existing mechanism explanations and the limitations discussion are retained.

D1.justification: v2's abstract announces release of code, checkpoint, and dataset and supplies a project link. v1 described public dataset release without that access link or code/checkpoint disclosure. Training hyperparameters, hardware, runtime information, and prompts remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds citations to GOMAA-Geo, OpenStreetView-5M, Around the World in 80 Timesteps, and GAGA. These broaden background coverage modestly; the related-work taxonomy and GeoRanker's positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited grammatical and terminology corrections, clarifies inference notation, corrects an author affiliation, and adds funding acknowledgements. Two appendix sections and their cross-references are inserted while the main narrative and existing section order remain stable.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 5 and 7, renumbers the existing complete-ablation table as Table 6, and relocates appendix figures within the layout. Figure 7 corrects GeoReranker labels to GeoRanker. Existing visual content and overall presentation remain largely unchanged.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1, the new ranking-metric evaluation and retrieval-pool sensitivity study provide targeted additional validation, while the project link improves documented reproducibility. The central method and existing results remain stable. The pool-size discussion slightly overstates monotonic improvement, but this limited interpretive weakness does not outweigh the added evidence and access information.
